bibliographic.title: Red Riding Wh*re
bibliographic.author: ruinouslore
bibliographic.description:
This was made in Twine for the Skeleton Jam 2025. The jam's main requirement is that the game is created with the default presentation of medium used and there's no assets added, hence the game is in the default Twine look.

WARNING: This is an 18+ game. There is an optional warning you can read at the beginning. Viewer discretion is advised.

It's a Little Red Riding Hood retelling(s), but Red is not little (she's an adult) and she's horny lesbian! And so is the wolf and lumberjack! And things get really fucked up sometimes!

This game is meant to be replayed up to three times, with new endings to be found. Play again right after you "complete" it to start a slightly different story, depending on your choices. Quitting to the menu will fully restart the story back to the "true" beginning. There is no deep meaning for the story, it's basically me liking too many ideas and blending them all together.  NOTE: The "Usual Path" and what follows after are the only fully complete paths right now. I overestimated my ability to write quickly, so "New Path" will be added after the Jam hopefully soon.

Features:
  • 8,000+ words (so far)
  • 4 "endings" (so far, 3 more soon)
  • evil horny gory lesbians
  • inconsistent writing styles cuz i tried to be funny but kept writing seriously too
